issues.symptom: Both used the top-right anchor; mobile toolbar wrapped over the native controls.
issues.rootCause: Independent overlays shared an anchor and mobile CSS lacked sufficient specificity.
issues.plannedFix: Move native controls to top-left and add scoped 390/320 top safe areas.

issues.symptom: Desktop navigation wrapped and a 360px desktop sidebar squeezed the tablet map.
issues.rootCause: Desktop UI began at md despite its measured minimum usable width.
issues.plannedFix: Move desktop gates to lg and use the existing BottomSheet through tablet width.

issues.symptom: Wrapped trigger placed the 240px menu partly outside the viewport and below a competing layer.
issues.rootCause: Right anchoring assumed a single-row toolbar and static z-index.
issues.plannedFix: Left-anchor at 320px and promote the open toolbar with an existing z-index token.

issues.symptom: Legend overlapped attribution; on short 320px screens it also crossed the left control rail.
issues.rootCause: Legend used bottom-4 and a fixed maximum width without reserving system-control lanes.
issues.plannedFix: Use bottom-12, BottomSheet-aware vertical clearance, and a narrower 320px width.
